decision.rationale: The official Faculty of Medicine REDI service offers substantive public equity and inclusion guidance, consultation, facilitation guides, educational recordings, and events. Explicit Vancouver campus events and the distributed Faculty of Medicine mandate establish broad UBC rather than exclusively Okanagan scope.
